headline: Dhunseri Investments releases postal ballot voting results
hook: Dhunseri Investments concludes postal ballot process
summary: Dhunseri Investments Limited has submitted the official proceedings and voting results of its recent postal ballot to the NSE. The filing includes the scrutinizer's report detailing the outcome of shareholder resolutions. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure required for listed entities. Retail investors can review the specific resolutions passed through the exchange portal.
why_it_matters: Routine governance update with no immediate impact on share price.
